Two residents of Osogbo, Osun State, were on Thursday remanded at the Ilesa Custodial Centre for allegedly attacking staff members of the Ibadan Electricity Distribution Company attached to its Oke-Ayepe office in Osogbo. The defendants, Hassan Adeshina, 38, and Isiaka Mukaila, 20, in suit number MOS/625/2026, appeared before Magistrate A. Daramola of the Osogbo Chief Magistrates’ Court. They were arraigned on six counts of assault, threat to life and conduct likely to cause a breach of public peace. According to the charge sheet, the defendants and others now at large, on October 21, 2026, attacked Mmadukwe Michael and Jimoh Rashidat at the IBEDC office located in the Oke-Ayepe area of Osogbo. The defendants were also alleged to have threatened the two IBEDC staff to surrender the money realised for the company on the day of the incident. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. In his ruling, Magistrate Daramola ordered that the defendants be remanded at the Ilesa Correctional Facility. The matter was adjourned till December 1, 2026, for further hearing. Bola Bamigbola
